en: Vintage sepia postcard depicting a European city street scene with cobblestone pavement, ornate multi‑story buildings, and an iron arch bridge over a river. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and horse‑drawn carriages are visible. The caption beneath the image reads "Kolozsvár. Szamosi vashíd." and the building on the right bears signage including the word "FONCIERE."
